text:
joel: kicking off the v2 rollout in the 02:00 UTC change window. planning a slow ramp 10% -> 100% over ~30m. heads-up for client pins and release notes.

deploy-bot: DEPLOYBOT: [1725554321] Rollout started: service=api-prod target=api/v2 traffic=10%->100% window=02:00-03:00UTC strategy=gradual canary=30m rollback-triggers={error_rate>2% for 5m, p95_latency>800ms for 5m} owner=@joel

```
# rollback (manual)
/deploybot rollback api-prod v2 --to v1 --reason "rollback-trigger"
# pause rollout
/deploybot pause api-prod v2 --at 50%
```

maya: @joel mobile SDK requests a pause at 50% until we validate v2.1 schema + header changes. please add tenant pins for enterprise customers.

joel: ack. will add an automatic canary pause at 50% and handoff to @paul for the mid-rollout checks.

paul: I'll watch telemetry and run the smoke suite. pls confirm pinlist so I can validate tenant traffic.

joel: pinning tenants now: tenant-omega, tenant-gamma (enterprise). updating deploybot pins.

deploy-bot: CMD: pins add api-prod tenant-omega tenant-gamma -> OK. Current pinned tenants: tenant-omega, tenant-gamma.

carla: quick heads-up — I updated the release notes draft: https://go/readme/api-v2 (draft). Important note: header change from `X-API-Compat` -> `X-Api-Version` (case-insensitive fallback recommended). Also documented SDK compatibility notes and recommended rollout checklist.

maya: Mobile team will ship a small SDK patch to handle case-insensitive header fallback for two weeks. planning to monitor crash-free rate. :thumbsup:

sam: if we need to rollback, want the plan spelled out: step 1) pause rollout, step 2) route traffic back to v1 canaries, step 3) open hotfix branch and notify customers. any objections?

joel: agree with that plan. also enabling automatic fallback: deploybot will trigger an automatic fallback to v1 if critical triggers fire. command to run manual instant rollback included above.

deploy-bot: NOTE: automatic fallback enabled for this rollout. If triggered, deploybot will: 1) create rollback ticket, 2) route traffic to v1, 3) notify #incidents and oncall.

paul: after we hit 50% and run the smoke tests I'll post results here. watching error_rate, p95, and mobile 4xx.

joel: keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the rollout. tagging release notes owner for post-deploy summary.

amelia: on it — will publish a short post-deploy blurb focusing on header migration steps and client impact. ETA ~1h after successful 100% ramp.

joel: thanks all. ping this thread if anything unexpected happens. :white_check_mark:
